scenarios.name: Navigate to a subfolder and back while choosing a save location

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the initial folder is a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-saving/SaveAsNativeFolder` with its `Subfolder` child
the dialog displays a proposed file name
the location breadcrumb and file list show the subfolder
the proposed file name remains in the file name field
the initial folder and its file list are displayed
the proposed file name remains in the file name field
